introNew: Describe a notebook, a simulator, a library or a pipeline and say where it lives. It is saved as a draft; an operator publishes it.
introEdit: Only a draft can be edited. The identifier does not change.
notEditable: This toolset can no longer be edited: only a draft can be, by the person who declared it.

slug.label: Identifier
slug.hint: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens. It becomes the address of the page and cannot be changed.

summary.label: Summary
summary.hint: What it does and what it is for, in a few sentences.

url.label: Web address
url.hint: Where the toolset lives: a repository, a registry, a landing page. Starts with https://.

version.label: Version
version.hint: Optional. The version this description is about.

licence.label: Licence
licence.hint: Optional. An SPDX identifier such as Apache-2.0, or the licence’s own name.

maintainer.label: Maintainer
maintainer.hint: The person or organisation that maintains it, as it should be shown.

contact.label: Contact
contact.hint: Optional. An address or a page where the maintainer can be reached. Shown publicly.

datasetSlugs.label: Datasets
datasetSlugs.hint: Optional. Identifiers of datasets of this catalogue, separated by commas.

modelCardSlugs.label: Models
modelCardSlugs.hint: Optional. Identifiers of model cards of this platform, separated by commas.

errors.signInRequired: Sign in to declare a toolset.
errors.slugTaken: Already in use; choose another identifier.
errors.unknownDatasets: Not in this catalogue, or you may not see it: {slugs}
errors.unknownModelCards: Not a model card of this platform, or you may not see it: {slugs}
errors.notFound: This toolset does not exist, or you cannot see it.

lifecycle.title: Status
lifecycle.DRAFT: A draft: only you and the operators see it. An operator publishes it.
lifecycle.DRAFTOperator: A draft, waiting to be published.
lifecycle.PUBLISHED: Published: anyone can find and open it.
lifecycle.WITHDRAWN: Withdrawn: it is no longer listed. This cannot be undone.
lifecycle.confirmWithdraw: Withdrawing cannot be undone. Withdraw this toolset?
lifecycle.invalid: This action could not be read.
lifecycle.forbidden: You may not make this change.
lifecycle.stale: The toolset has changed in the meantime. Reload the page.
